symptoms: Small circular brown necrotic spots on leaves, coalescing into large patches causing defoliation
prevention: Ensure canopy aeration by selective branch thinning

healthy_signs: Glossy green canopy with active flush of new growth
Symmetrical fruit development with clean rind free from anthracnose spots or fruit-fly punctures
Intact branch terminals without dieback or gummosis
Healthy root zone with efficient moisture absorption
management: Prune infected twigs 5 cm into healthy tissue and paste cut ends with copper oxychloride
Collect and deeply bury fallen diseased fruits in compost pits with lime
Apply balanced micronutrient foliar spray (zinc, boron, iron) to restore tree vigor
prevention: Sanitize orchards by pruning dead, crisscrossing, or diseased twigs after harvest
Paint trunk bases with Bordeaux paste (1:1:10) before monsoon onset to prevent foot rot
Ensure adequate drainage in tree basins; prevent standing water near the trunk
Install methyl eugenol fruit fly traps across orchard borders
